when_to_use: 文件管理器式目录浏览
prompt_en: Build a single File Tree, not a full page. Structure: an indented tree of folders and files with carets and file-type glyphs, one node selected with a tinted row. Interaction: carets expand/collapse, click a node to select it, double-click a folder toggles too. States: expanded, collapsed, selected, hover. Motion: 150ms expand. Do not allow multi-select. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个文件树，不是整页。结构：文件夹与文件的缩进树，带展开箭头与文件类型符号，一个节点选中着色。交互：箭头展开/收起，点节点选中，双击文件夹同样切换。状态：展开、收起、选中、悬停。动效：150ms 展开。不允许多选。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 层级数据的多选（含父子联动）
prompt_en: Build a single Checkable Tree, not a full page. Structure: a two-level tree where each node has a checkbox; parent checkboxes show checked / indeterminate / unchecked based on children. Interaction: checking a parent checks all children, unchecking a child updates parent to indeterminate, a footer line lists checked count. States: checked, indeterminate, unchecked, hover. Motion: 100ms check transition. Do not use radio buttons. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个勾选树，不是整页。结构：两层树，每节点带勾选框；父级勾选框根据子级呈现 全选/半选/未选。交互：勾父级全选子级，取消子级后父级变半选，底部一行显示已选数量。状态：全选、半选、未选、悬停。动效：100ms 勾选过渡。不要用单选按钮。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 组织架构的横向层级展示
prompt_en: Build a single horizontal Org Tree, not a full page. Structure: a root node (公司) at top connected by elbow lines to two child nodes, one child having two leaf nodes below it; nodes are compact cards. Interaction: click a node highlights it and its path to root. States: default, highlighted path, hover. Motion: 120ms highlight. Do not lay it out vertically like a file tree. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个横向组织架构树，不是整页。结构：根节点（公司）在顶部，用折线连接两个子节点，其中一个子节点下挂两个叶子；节点为紧凑卡片。交互：点节点高亮它及到根的路径。状态：默认、路径高亮、悬停。动效：120ms 高亮。不要排成纵向文件树。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Searchable Tree, not a full page. Structure: a search input above a five-level file tree; typing filters to matching nodes and auto-expands their ancestor paths, highlighting matched text. Interaction: typing filters live, clearing restores the tree, match highlights persist. States: idle, filtering, matches highlighted, no-match hint. Motion: 150ms expand. Do not collapse matched branches. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个可搜索树，不是整页。结构：搜索输入框在五层文件树上方；输入过滤出匹配节点并自动展开其祖先路径，命中文字高亮。交互：实时过滤，清空恢复整树，高亮保留。状态：空闲、过滤中、命中高亮、无匹配提示。动效：150ms 展开。不要收起命中的分支。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Draggable Tree, not a full page. Structure: a flat-looking list of three items and one folder where leaf items can be dragged into or out of the folder with a drop highlight. Interaction: drag a leaf onto the folder to nest it (row indents, folder opens), drag out to flatten. States: idle, dragging, drop-target highlighted. Motion: 150ms indent shift. Do not allow dragging the folder itself. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个可拖拽树，不是整页。结构：扁平列表含三个条目与一个文件夹，叶子条目可拖入/拖出文件夹并有落点高亮。交互：拖叶子到文件夹上嵌套（行缩进、文件夹展开），拖出还原。状态：空闲、拖动中、落点高亮。不要允许拖动文件夹本身。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Comment Thread, not a full page. Structure: one root comment (avatar monogram, name, two-line text, 回复 link) with two nested replies indented under a left guide line; one reply has its own nested reply. Interaction: 回复 link opens a tiny inline input under that comment, Enter adds a nested reply. States: default, input open, newly added highlight. Motion: 200ms expand of the input. Do not flatten replies. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个嵌套评论树，不是整页。结构：一条根评论（字母头像、昵称、两行文字、回复链接）+ 左侧引导线缩进的两条回复，其中一条再嵌套一条。交互：点回复在该评论下展开迷你输入框，Enter 添加嵌套回复。状态：默认、输入展开、新回复高亮。动效：输入框 200ms 展开。不要把回复拍平。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
